_evidence: DRAFT (owner-pending) structural mapping for the Asianomist legacy import (asn-launch W2, 05-11-26). No site id, no image host: those live in the owner-held overlay ~/asn-private/overlay.json. Every key in _provisional is an OWNER DECISION still open; the values are SUGGESTIONS only and --require-final (implied for any non-local run) refuses them. The old site row in public.sites is expected at slug asianomist (apcg-network/sites/asianomist.json) but is NOT confirmed: run sql/01-discover-asn.sql first and re-check every value below against its section 3 (section/subsection x status). Legacy taxonomy (asianomist.json): the-brief {morning-brief, week-ahead, weekend-read}; economies {southeast-asia, greater-china, japan-korea, india-south-asia, asia-world}; markets {markets-today, central-banks-currencies, stocks-bonds, ipo-deals, crypto-digital-assets}; banking-fintech {banks, payments-lending, insurtech-wealthtech}; industries {supply-chain, tech-semiconductors, energy-commodities, consumer-retail, real-estate-infrastructure}; wealth {investing, savings-rates, property-investment, expat-money}; columns-explainers {columns, explainers}; press-room {press-releases, company-announcements, market-notices}. Open decisions: (1) status.map: suggestion published only, like agr/amb; catch-up runs before cutover pick up what the old site publishes later. (2) categories.map: legacy subsections equal to a new sub-section slug pass through 1:1; economies/greater-china goes to economies/china (economies/china is also mapped, for catch-up runs); the-brief/morning-brief goes to the-brief with NO sub-section (Morning Brief = a the-brief article without sub-section); the legacy banking-fintech and wealth subsections (banks, payments-lending, insurtech-wealthtech; investing, savings-rates, property-investment, expat-money) go to their pillar with NO sub-section (the new design has none there); columns-explainers/columns goes to columns and columns-explainers/explainers goes to explainers; columns-explainers with an empty or unknown subsection has NO entry on purpose (it cannot be split without a human): unmapped is reject, so such a row stops the run until the owner picks columns or explainers; columns/* and explainers/* are mapped for catch-up runs; press-room/* goes to press-room with no sub-section (single-home); every other pillar keeps a <pillar>/* fallback to the pillar with no sub-section. (3) authors: even split over the 6 staff names of the design's Team page (mode even, per-author counts differ by at most 1, like agr/amb); legacy bylines are not kept. (4) tags: only the 6 proposed tags survive (D6, themselves owner-pending); no renames until the discovery's top-40 tag list is read. (5) media.bodyImages: drop (default, counted) or hero-if-missing; decide after the body image count. The old image library (media_assets) goes to the content-engine Media Engine in a separate plan, not through this mapping. (6) body.reflowMaxChars: 380 is the aer/agr/amb value (same legacy platform: each section is stored as one block and split at render time); confirm on a few old article pages after the first dry run. (7) archivedAs section (301 to the article section page) vs 410. (8) old origin apex https://asianomist.com (www.asianomist.com is an alias) and article path /article/{slug} (the old site's pattern; its sitemap lists /article/<slug>); section paths are the old pillars, including /columns-explainers. With redirectNonPillarSectionsToMappedPillar the builder sends /columns-explainers to the pillar of the first row it sees, so the plan's /columns-explainers 301 /columns, /press-room-submit 301 /press-room/submit and the /studio and /data routes are hand-written in asianomist-web at cutover, not taken from this mapping (extraLegacyPaths and gonePaths stay empty, as agr/amb).
